title: Mary, Prepare Us
style: High-energy contemporary gospel, brisk driving groove with handclaps and stomping tambourine, rich piano chords, warm organ, buoyant bass, and bright brass accents. Mezzo-soprano lead solo with expressive gospel phrasing, answered by a full diverse mixed choir in bold harmonies; build from intimate opening prayer to a soaring communal refrain, drop to a tender reflective bridge, then rise into a joyful final call-and-response and resolved amen. Live-room warmth, clear lead vocal, wide choir, punchy rhythmic mix.
lyrics:
[Intro]
O sovereign Mary, hear our prayer
Prepare our souls with tender care

[Verse 1: Lead]
For all thy virtues, for thy humility
God chose thee to be the mother of His Son
Prepare my soul, and every soul
Who keeps this novena in this season
For the spiritual birth of thy beloved Son

[Call and Response]
[Lead] Mary, prepare us!
[Choir] Prepare us, prepare us!
[Lead] Make our hearts ready!
[Choir] Make our hearts ready!
[Lead] For the birth of thy Son!
[Choir] We wait in faith and love!

[Verse 2: Lead]
O sweetest Mother, share with us
That deep recollection, divine tenderness
With which thou waited for thy Son
Teach us to behold Him, love Him, worship Him
Now and throughout eternity

[Chorus]
[Lead] Make us ready, make us worthy!
[Choir] Ready, worthy, hearts made new!
[Lead] Let us behold Him, love and worship!
[Choir] Through all time, our praise to You!
[Lead] Mary, guide us to thy Son!
[Choir] Amen, amen!

[Bridge: Lead]
In quiet wonder, keep us near
In tender faith, replace our fear
[Choir] Prepare our souls, prepare our souls
[Lead] That we may welcome Him with love
[Choir] Prepare our souls, prepare our souls

[Final Call and Response]
[Lead] Who prepares our hearts?
[Choir] Mary, Mother, lead us on!
[Lead] Who shall we behold?
[Choir] Jesus, God's beloved Son!
[Lead] Who shall we love and worship?
[Choir] Him through all eternity!
[All] Amen! Amen! Amen!
